cases.name: free boundary
cases.evidence: Free access and no member data; workout persistence rejected.

cases.name: cross-user isolation
cases.evidence: Member B saw zero member A assignment, workout, set, proposal and decision rows; non-owned decision rejected.

cases.name: invalid binding and altered replay
cases.evidence: Cross-member persistence and altered controlled-assignment replay rejected without count changes.

cases.name: workout idempotency
cases.evidence: Exact replay returned the original UUID; altered same-client replay rejected without stored-payload change.

cases.name: profiles.role negative control
cases.evidence: Existing coach-labelled profile remained free/no-coaching and could not persist a workout; profiles were not mutated.

cases.name: natural entitlement expiry
cases.evidence: Access became free after natural expiry, but assignment/program/history remained readable and sub_persist_completed_workout_v1 accepted a new workout.

cases.name: rollback and freeze decision
cases.evidence: No new activations or assignments; retained shadow and evidence for remediation; rollback not executed.
